semiconductor_relevance: Medium — PMC provides compliance and safety consulting services relevant to semiconductor manufacturing but does not directly supply semiconductor products or equipment.
summary: Precision Machinery Research & Development Center (PMC) is a service center specializing in CE marking consulting and examination, helping machinery companies meet European standards. They also provide SEMI safety standards compliance support for microelectronics and related industries.
capabilities: Machinery and electric safety design consulting
technical_expertise: Compliance with European Union Machinery Directive
Compliance with European Union Low Voltage Directive

regional_presence.Taiwan: PMC is located in Taiwan's Golden Valley and has been active in supporting local industries since 1993.
